final_rationale: The verdict does not change. The Actor did not provide genuinely new admissible evidence; the response narrows and caveats the claim using the same record already available. That reframing is analytically better than a clean no-disclosure position, but it does not satisfy the policy predicate for compliance. The admissible evidence still shows a 1.1-point miss in a named contractual customer segment, an open legal review on disclosure, and a policy requiring material limitations for named launch use cases to be resolved, disclosed, or covered by approved risk acceptance before launch. No admissible evidence establishes any of those curing conditions. A caveated certification rationale may be a more accurate description of business posture, but it is not enough for compliant_with_caveats when the caveat itself is an unresolved mandatory compliance condition rather than a bounded residual risk.
remaining_concerns: No new admissible evidence shows the multilingual customer support limitation was resolved before launch.
No new admissible evidence shows the material limitation was disclosed in the required launch artifact.
No new admissible evidence shows approved risk acceptance covering this specific limitation before launch.
The affected segment remains material under policy because it is named in two regional support commitments and legal review is still open.
Aggregate readiness and lack of severity-one rehearsal incidents do not satisfy the separate disclosure-or-risk-acceptance requirement for a material limitation.
